newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Lek drops 5 pct in correction.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Lek drops 5 pct in correction.

text.p: Slovenian pharmaceutical company Lek fell five percent during early trade on Tuesday on what traders said was continued profit-taking from last week's heady gains.
"After such big gains some profit taking is no surprise at all," one trader said.
Last week alone, Lek jumped over 42 percent, with demand boosted by the central bank's decision to relax rules for foreign investors.
At 0920 GMT Lek was down five percent or 1,650 tolars to 31,350 tolars on volume of 1,137 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
